content_of_post_to_comment: I submitted a recent essay to LessWrong, and they rejected it because it didn't meet these two criteria: Be short and to the point Anticipate and respond to every objection I wonder if they noticed that these criteria are completely contradictory.
comment: The tension may be less about length versus rigor and more about audience trust: a short essay can anticipate objections by changing the reader's mental model, not by listing every possible rebuttal.
